title: 「韩娱嘉年华」品牌视觉升级全流程分享
schema_note: workflow_steps[].stage_type, evidence_type, confidence, order_confidence, order_basis, and workflow_completeness reuse the exact enums defined in ../../baseline_pilot/schema/design_workflow_schema_v0.1.json. Case-level sections below (brief, exploration_inputs, candidate_outputs, comparison, selection, refinement, applications) are additive — baseline_pilot's schema has no case-level equivalent for these (baseline only carries per-step selected_output/selection_reason). See QUALITY_REVIEW.md 'schema compatibility' for the full mapping and its limitations.

brief.summary: Page states, under the heading 一、项目背景 (Project Background), that the event has grown and the brand identity needed a visual upgrade.

persona.summary: A 用户画像 (user persona) stage is referenced between the project-background and moodboard sections, per the Phase 5 findings narrative.
persona.limitation: Only the stage label is confirmed to exist (via Phase 5 narrative, not a dedicated Phase 5 evidence row); no persona content/detail text has been captured in Phase 5 or Phase 6, so persona substance is unconfirmed.

moodboard.summary: 情绪板 (moodboard) collage of roughly 15 reference images (K-pop album covers, fan-support visuals, award-show KVs).
moodboard.reference_image_category: K-pop / fandom visual culture references (broad category only)
moodboard.interpretation_limit: Individual reference images are not identified (no attempt made to identify specific artists, brands, or source works). No page text was found explicitly stating how these references drove the subsequent logo/KV work; the moodboard's influence on later stages is a plausible reading of page order, not a documented causal claim.

keywords.result: 活力 / 狂热 / 甜酷
keywords.limitation: The keyword result is documented in the Phase 5 findings narrative, but the extraction process/reasoning behind arriving at these three keywords is not shown on the page.

workflow_steps.title: 项目背景 (Project background)
workflow_steps.description: Section explaining the event's growth and the need to refresh the brand identity.
workflow_steps.notes: Numbered section heading (一、) confirms this is the page's first documented stage; no further numbered headings were confirmed for later sections, so order_confidence is capped at medium rather than high.

workflow_steps.title: 用户画像 (User persona)
workflow_steps.description: Stage label referenced in Phase 5 findings narrative between project background and moodboard; content not confirmed.
missing_information: Persona content/detail text (target audience description, demographics, etc.) was not captured; only the stage's existence is documented.
workflow_steps.notes: Downgraded to low confidence per Phase 6 rule: a persona stage represented only by a label, without visible descriptive content, must not be treated as a fully evidenced stage.

workflow_steps.title: 情绪板 (Moodboard)
workflow_steps.description: Collage of roughly 15 reference images under the 情绪板 heading.
missing_information: No page text found explicitly linking specific moodboard images to specific later design decisions.
workflow_steps.notes: Existence and visual content category of the moodboard are confirmed; it is not treated as a formal creative-direction statement in its own right.

workflow_steps.title: 关键词提取 (Keyword extraction)
workflow_steps.description: Keyword result 活力/狂热/甜酷 documented in the Phase 5 findings narrative.
missing_information: Extraction method/reasoning not shown on page.
workflow_steps.notes: Mapped to baseline stage_type 'creative_direction' as the closest enum match; baseline schema has no dedicated 'keyword_extraction' value. See QUALITY_REVIEW.md schema compatibility section.

workflow_steps.title: LOGO草图 (Logo sketches)
workflow_steps.description: 8 black-and-white hand-drawn-style logo sketches in a 4x2 grid.
missing_information: formal_direction_count is unknown: the page does not state that each of the 8 sketches was a formally proposed direction.
workflow_steps.notes: observed_variant_count=8; variant_type=exploration_sketch. interpretation_limit: the page shows eight sketch variants but does not establish that each was a formally proposed direction, a formal candidate comparison, a customer decision point, or the source of the final selected output. This evidence alone supports has_sketches / exploration breadth / early concept variation only.

workflow_steps.title: LOGO概念 (Logo concept rationale)
workflow_steps.description: Paragraph explaining the V + ring + heart + speech-bubble symbolism of the final logo mark.
workflow_steps.notes: rationale_scope=final_logo_concept. This rationale explains the final logo's symbol construction; it is not recorded as an individual rationale for each of the 8 sketches, and no broader brand-strategy meaning beyond the stated symbolism is claimed.

workflow_steps.title: 版本一 / 版本二 (Two final logo versions, side by side)
workflow_steps.description: Two distinct finished logo lockups shown side by side and labeled 版本一 and 版本二.
missing_information: No selection statement, comparison-dimension text, or client decision was found between 版本一 and 版本二.
No documented link from any specific one of the 8 sketches to either final version.
workflow_steps.notes: observed_candidate_count=2; side_by_side_comparison=true. Per ZCE-CAND-001-E011, page text distinguishes the two versions by usage context (版本一 = default; 版本二 = for a dated campaign placement), not by selection or preference. This usage-context note must not be read as a selection rationale.

workflow_steps.title: Sketch-to-final progression
workflow_steps.description: Visual progression from the 8-sketch grid, to an exploded logo-concept breakdown (heart+ring+bubble+V icons), to the final vector lockup.
missing_information: No text confirms this is an actual iteration history rather than three separately-authored explanatory panels (sketches / concept breakdown / final mark) shown in page order.
workflow_steps.notes: Recorded as refinement only because a plausible before/after progression is visually inferable from page order; not recorded as a confirmed iteration history. Must not be confused with a brand-guidelines panel or a plain final-application showcase.

workflow_steps.title: 落地效果 (On-site event applications)
workflow_steps.description: Section 3.4 落地效果 with on-site event photography (booth, signage, crowd) and an embedded recap video.
missing_information: No user-testing, commercial-effect, or event-success metric evidence found alongside these application photos.
workflow_steps.notes: Establishes that the visual system reached real-world application; does not establish which intermediate decisions (persona, sketch-to-version, or KV/IP paths) led to these specific applications.

candidate_outputs.label: 版本一 (Version 1)
candidate_outputs.usage_note: Described in Phase 5 findings narrative as the default version.

candidate_outputs.label: 版本二 (Version 2)
candidate_outputs.usage_note: Described in Phase 5 findings narrative as used for a dated campaign placement.

comparison.summary: 版本一 and 版本二 final logo lockups are shown side by side. No comparison criteria (e.g. legibility, versatility, brand fit) are stated on the page.

selection.limitation: Explicit selection result and rationale were not found in the reviewed page evidence, for either the 8-sketch stage or the 版本一/版本二 stage. This matches Phase 5's has_selection_reason=false, which is carried forward unchanged.

refinement.summary: A plausible sketch -> concept-breakdown -> final-mark progression is visually inferable from page order.
refinement.limitation: Not recorded as a confirmed iteration history; page order is the only basis for the implied sequence.

applications.description: Crowd / on-site environment photography under 3.4 落地效果.
Embedded event recap video under 3.4 落地效果.

missing_information: has_selection_reason=false is unchanged from Phase 5: no explicit statement of why any one of the 8 sketches, or either of the two final logo versions, was chosen.

KV (key visual) exploration and IP/mascot exploration are mentioned only in the Phase 5 findings narrative ('KV concept and execution', 'IP exploration reasoning') with no dedicated Phase 5 evidence_id and no confirmable specific content at the resolution available in Phase 6; they are excluded from workflow_steps rather than recorded with fabricated detail.
Persona content/detail beyond the stage label is unconfirmed.
Keyword-extraction method/reasoning behind 活力/狂热/甜酷 is unconfirmed.
Whether the 8 sketches map onto 8 formally proposed creative directions is unconfirmed (formal_direction_count=unknown).
Whether either final logo version was actually selected by a client, and on what basis, is unconfirmed.
